description: This file contains utility functions for persisting and retrieving user profile data, skills, education, projects, languages, and career preferences from a Supabase database. It includes functions for loading, saving, updating, and deleting profile-related data, with a focus on safety and consistency.

methods.name: getCurrentUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's ID from Supabase, returning a safe error object if not available.

methods.name: loadProfileAndSkillsFromSupabase
methods.description: Loads the user's profile, skills, education, projects, languages, and career preferences from Supabase.

methods.name: saveProfileAndSkillsToSupabase
methods.description: Saves or updates the user's profile, skills, education, projects, languages, and career preferences into Supabase.

methods.name: deleteEducationFromSupabase
methods.description: Deletes all education records for the current user.

methods.name: deleteProjectsFromSupabase
methods.description: Deletes all project records for the current user.

methods.name: deleteLanguagesFromSupabase
methods.description: Deletes all language records for the current user.

methods.name: deleteCareerPreferencesFromSupabase
methods.description: Deletes the career preferences record for the current user.
